The Taichung High Court of the second instance today commuted the sentence to life imprisonment and seized public power for life. After administering drugs at his home in Miaoli City on the afternoon of October 2 last year, Qiu Mingzhi thought of random killing. He tied a kitchen knife to his left hand and then rode out. 59ca3fb65d0a49d99cd6.en:
The Disease Control Agency announced today (18) a new case of local dengue fever, a male in his 30s living in Changhua City, Changhua County. In early September, he sought medical attention for fever symptoms, but the symptoms did not improve. After reporting and testing, he was diagnosed with dengue fever on September 17, and the first type of dengue virus was detected. The case is currently hospitalized, and there are no suspected symptoms in close contacts.

The CDC said that the main place of activity during the incubation period of the case is the home and workplace of Changhua County. There is also a history of activities in neighboring counties and cities. There is no history of foreign travel. It has been determined that the case is a local case. The source of infection remains to be clarified. Relevant health units have carried out emergency chemical control work, vector mosquito density surveys and environmental risk assessments in the vicinity of the case residence or activity site, and strengthened breeding source removal and hygiene education, calling on the public to implement mosquito control measures and cooperate with related prevention and control efforts.

The Disease Control Agency (hereinafter referred to as CDC) said today (15) that the influenza and COVID-19 epidemics are in an epidemic period and the influenza epidemic continues to rise. The public should strengthen the prevention of respiratory infectious diseases such as influenza and COVID-19. It is recommended to wear masks independently in places with frequent hand washing, coughing etiquette, large crowds or poor ventilation. 2d0976e8f5dda06400e9.en: Multidrug-resistant tuberculosis (MDR-TB) means that the tuberculosis bacteria infected by the patient are at least resistant to the first-line drugs isonicotinamide (INH) and panamycin (RMP), which are classified as the second type of statutory infectious diseases in China. Treatment is more complex than usual tuberculosis, and the efficacy and side effects should be monitored closely and continuously during treatment. In order to optimize the care of drug-resistant tuberculosis patients and avoid the risk of derivative treatment failure and community transmission, the CDC (hereinafter referred to as the CDC) has established a multi-drug-resistant tuberculosis medical care team (Taiwan MDR-TB Consortium, TMTC team) since 2007, integrating medical, public health, testing, pharmaceutical affairs, nursing and other team resources to provide patient treatment drugs at public expense.

80c2528141c724c8802b.en: The flu pandemic continued to raise alarms. Last week, the number of outpatient influenza-like outpatients in Taiwan approached 140,000, and 87 cases of severe illness and 30 deaths were added. The number of deaths exceeded the record for the flu season. Among them, a 2-year-old boy in the south still died in hospital about 2 weeks after being diagnosed with influenza A. In order to strengthen the protection of the public, the first phase of the publicly-funded COVID-19 and influenza vaccines will be launched on October 1, and people over the age of 18 can earn 1,350 health coins as long as they receive the "left and right new" vaccines.
